server_message_facts.provider: pkg/permissionbundle.ServerMessageFactProvider implements NativeIMFactProvider over octo-server's own storage
storage_read: sharded message tables (message, message<N>) via the module's own DB.getTable
message_user_extra and channel_offset (per-user delete / clear history), channel_setting.offset_message_seq
group, group_member, thread (native membership and thread state)
server_message_facts.shared_helpers: modules/message.NewServerMessageFactHooks supplies shard naming, visibles whitelist (visiblesAllows), payload space tag (extractPayloadSpaceID) and system-principal test (space.IsSystemBot); the package carries no default copy and refuses to construct without them
server_message_facts.header_reference: h1-<same fields>, always carrying the current native version
server_message_facts.metadata_only: no message, quote or media body is placed in any returned value; payload_sha256 is the contract-mandated digest of the current effective body (edited content when edited)
server_message_facts.deny_before_body: resolve and history headers return metadata only; the permit from IssueHistoryDisclosureV1 is an HMAC token bound to bot, space, context id, epoch, header reference and payload digest and is issued only after current re-resolution
server_message_facts.two_step_disclosure: preserved: ListHistoryHeadersV1 then IssueHistoryDisclosureV1; the atomic header-plus-body substitute is not implemented or activated

proven_now.dm: source identity, author, message version (exact only when the reference carries the current version), tagged space (payload space_id == key space), current read for both principals including visibles, per-user delete, per-user and channel clear-history, revoke/delete/non-persisted outcomes, and original visibility for the two DM participants
proven_now.group_thread: source, parent group, space (group.space_id), thread deletion, current membership/read/send for author and bot, visibles exclusion as a definite write-time false, revoke/delete/edit outcomes

explicit_unknown_non_serving.mechanism: IMResolvedDelivery.MessageSpaceUnknown / MessageVersionUnknown / CallerOriginalVisibleUnknown / BotOriginalVisibleUnknown; SQLNativeFactAdapter returns that reference as status=unavailable reason=predicate_unsupported (original-visibility unknowns apply to admit and contributor, not reply)
cases: DM message with no payload space_id tag (default-space forward compatibility needs state this provider does not assume)
group/thread original visibility: octo-server keeps no membership history, so a past membership gap cannot be excluded; only a visibles exclusion is provable (false)
explicit_unknown_non_serving.counterexample: group_member rows carry only the current is_deleted/status; a member who left and rejoined is indistinguishable from continuous membership at message time

unavailable_reasons.mirror_lag: no row in the message shard for the reference (never persisted or not yet written; not distinguished)
unavailable_reasons.expired_reference: revoked, deleted, thread deleted, group not in a readable state
unavailable_reasons.predicate_unsupported: malformed or foreign reference, unknown predicate

server_message_facts.cut: IMAuthorityCut is a read-time marker over ordinary SQL state with an operator-provided 32-hex store incarnation; it is not an acknowledged-state or restore-safe fence
server_message_facts.not_wired_into_startup: the provider is an isolated seam; no startup path constructs it and no no-op authority is installed

ordinary_sql_vs_failover_restore.verified_ordinary_sql: Prepare, independent atomic CAS Save, complete GET readback, reopen of the same store file retaining incarnation/digest/denies, concurrent CAS and ambiguous commit, and choice-B unchanged departed-member DENY, on plain SQL with the fixture authority
ordinary_sql_vs_failover_restore.not_claimed: failover, restore, PITR or RPO0 safety of acknowledged state; a same-DB counter or SQL writable flag is not independent proof; manual reconciliation is not equivalent
ordinary_sql_vs_failover_restore.guarantee_delta_vs_v44: v44 fenced-authority acknowledgement (RecoverAtLeast, election generation) is optional and non-production; without it a restored or rolled-back database can re-serve older bundle revisions. The simpler replacement contract is owned by XIN-2830, not defined here.
ordinary_sql_vs_failover_restore.live_startup: opt-in InstallFromEnv still refuses to serve without a configured authority and returns an explicit ErrUnavailable; nothing fabricates readiness

open_decisions.question: The endpoint's recvPacket fields (message id, channel, channel type) can build a delivery reference, but the native version token is not in them. Without it resolve returns unavailable/predicate_unsupported by design.
open_decisions.smallest_adjustment: either the endpoint reads the current message_extra version from the existing server sync/extra response and puts it in the reference, or the server adds a private metadata-only version peek. Neither is implemented here.
